content:
“Don't step here!”

**Light Footed** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

While sneaking, you never trigger mines or floor-based traps

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | While sneaking, you never trigger mines or floor-based traps. | 000B9882 | 

- This perk can be used to avoid triggering damage from player C.A.M.P. traps, such as punji boards.
- This perk's listing in the *Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide* has an alternative Vault Boy illustration, depicting him walking through a minefield, past a "!DANGER!" sign.
